1.  The present petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking direction to respondents No. 1 & 2 to take necessary steps towards payment of compensation by initiating the proceedings for land acquisition under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that his land was taken over for construction of pond.

He would further submit that despite the fact that the land of the petitioner was taken over,
the petitioner has not been paid any compensation till date.
3. Learned State counsel prays time to seek instructions.

sentences.text: Considering the submission made by counsel for the petitioner, in the opinion of this Court no purpose would be served by keeping the petition pending as the issue revolves around the fact finding, therefore, the respondents are directed to enquire the fact and demarcate the land of the petitioner which has been alleged to have been taken over for construction of pond and if the petitioner has been deprived of the ownership of the land the said demarcation be carried out and thereafter, the proceeding for acquisition may be done in accordance with law.
It is further directed that the said proceeding may be completed within an outer limit of 6 months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
5. With the aforesaid observation, the petition is disposed of.
